notes: German loanword, stress on the second syllable and an sh where the spelling shows an s: guh-SHTALT, never GES-talt. Developers meet it in Gestalt pattern matching (Python's difflib) and in design-system writing about perceptual grouping; GestaltX, an iOS MobileGestalt editor, was the top new GitHub repository the week of 2026-11-09 (6k+ stars).
